title: Settings › about
expect: The production About page opens directly on both platforms.
With no approved author text, the author card is absent, including its section. Version, Privacy, Open Source & Licenses, Website and the one-sentence privacy promise remain.
Privacy opens the existing website privacy page. The license is readable in-app.

iPhone and Mac App Store builds show only Version and no update UI. Direct Mac builds show update status below Version and push a detail with status, Check for Updates and Automatic Updates, without repeating Version.
Version is the leading title and the release version is a trailing secondary value, using the same layout as other value rows; update status remains a subtitle on direct Mac builds.
